description.value: Niji is an Asian restaurant situated on Dunsmuir Avenue in Cumberland, a village well known as a mountain biking hub on Vancouver Island. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a welcoming spot to wind down after a ride. It operates out of a two-storey retail building in the village core.
